title: Mycobacteria DNA extraction using bead disruption - Manual method
author: Patrick Camp
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.nsgdebw

steps.title: Prepare bead beater tubes
steps.instruction: Prepare 2ml sealed screw cap bead beater tubes by adding 200µl ± 100µl of 0.1mm silica beads.

steps.title: Prepare 1X TE buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 1X TE by adding 500µl of Tris-EDTA Buffer 100X Concentrate to 45.5ml of H20.

steps.title: Add TE buffer to tubes
steps.instruction: Add 400µl of 1X TE into the bead beater tubes containing silica beads.

steps.title: Prepare and add PCI
steps.instruction: Prepare Phenol/Chloroform/Isoamyl alcohol (PCI) 25:24:1 (v:v:v) in a 50ml conical tube inside a fume hood, calculating 400µl per sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 400µl of PCI into the bead beater tubes.

steps.title: Prepare equipment and reagents
steps.instruction: Set the centrifuge to cool down to 4°C and place 70% and 100% Ethanol in the -20°C freezer.

steps.title: Inoculate samples
steps.instruction: In a Biological Safety Cabinet, add 2-3 loopfuls of growth from solid media to the prepared bead beater tubes containing 1X TE and PCI.

steps.title: Bead beat samples
steps.instruction: Beat the samples at full speed for 2 minutes (depending on machine) using the Beadbeater machine.

steps.title: Centrifuge samples
steps.instruction: Spin samples at 16,000 ± 500 × g for 5 ± 1 minute.

steps.title: Prepare precipitation tube
steps.instruction: While samples are spinning, add 30μl of 3 M sodium acetate buffer solution to a labeled 1.5ml microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Recover aqueous layer
steps.instruction: Pipette approximately 300μl of the top aqueous layer (containing DNA) and add it to the 1.5ml microcentrifuge tube containing the 3 M sodium acetate buffer solution.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: Add 700µl of 100% ice-cold ethanol to the samples.

substeps.instruction: Vortex at full speed for < 2 seconds.

steps.title: Cool samples
steps.instruction: Cool samples at -80°C for 10-15 minutes (alternatively, place in -20°C freezer for 30 min or indefinitely).

steps.title: Wash DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Pour off the ethanol and add 1 ml ice-cold 70% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Immediately remove remaining ethanol with a 100-200μl pipette, placing the tip on the opposite side from the pellet.

steps.title: Dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Dry the samples at room temperature with tubes tilted and caps open for 15-20 minutes or until remaining ethanol has evaporated.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Add 300µl of 1X TE buffer (or a smaller volume if a small amount of DNA is expected).

substeps.instruction: Scrape the inside of the tube with the pipette tip when resuspending the DNA.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Store DNA at 4°C for short term or -80°C for long term storage.
